component.name: Heretic shareware installer
component.summary: Heretic, classic dark fantasy first person shooter, shareware installer

description.p: Heretic is Raven's classic dark fantasy first person shooter using a modified Doom engine. The Heretic engine is Open Source. The original Heretic datafiles however are not Open Source. There is a gratis, but not Open Source shareware version available on the internet.

This package contains an applications menu entry for playing Heretic shareware using the vavoom engine. The first time you click this menu entry, it will offer to download and install the Heretic shareware datafiles for you.
